title: Perfect complexes generate the quasi-coherent derived category
statement: For every quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme X [def-pc-scheme], the smallest strictly full subcategory of D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X) [def-pc-derived-category] that contains every perfect complex [def-pc-perfect-complex] and is closed under shifts, cones, retracts, and arbitrary set-indexed direct sums is all of D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X).

proof.text: Apply supported_perfect_generator to T = X. The support condition is vacuous, so its triangulated-property conclusion gives that D_QCoh(X) is triangulated. Quasi-coherent cohomology is invariant under derived isomorphisms by functoriality of cohomology and isomorphism invariance of quasi-coherent modules.

Apply supported_derived_generated_perfect with V the empty open, which is compact. Its support conditions are vacuous. Obtain a perfect object G and, for every Y, a sequence K starting at zero, distinguished transition triangles K_n -> K_(n+1) -> C_n -> K_n[1] with C_n a coproduct of shifts of G, and a distinguished telescope triangle S -> S -> Y -> S[1], where S is a coproduct of the K_n.

Fix any property P in the intersection defining perfectLocalizingClosure. Lift P to the ambient derived category by R(A) iff there exists a proof that A has quasi-coherent cohomology and P holds of the corresponding full-subcategory object. Full-subcategory isomorphisms and proof irrelevance show R is isomorphism-closed; the closure assumptions on P make R shift-closed and cone-closed, using the triangulated closure of quasi-coherence. The generator G satisfies R, and its contractible distinguished triangle G -> G -> 0 proves R(0). Rotation of distinguished triangles gives closure under the middle term as well.

For any u-small colimiting cofan of objects satisfying R, schemeDerivedQCohClosedUnderCoproducts gives quasi-coherence of its point. The coproduct closure of P then implies R of that point. This includes empty and singleton coproducts.

Induct on n. The initial K_0 is zero, hence in R. Every attaching coproduct C_n is in R since shifts of G are; the transition triangle and middle-term closure put K_(n+1) in R. Reindex the countable cofan S by ULift.{u} Nat using Equiv.ulift, preserving its universal property and bringing its index into the closure universe Type u. Hence S satisfies R. Cone closure in the final telescope triangle gives R(Y), so P(Y). Since P was arbitrary in the defining intersection, every Y lies in perfectLocalizingClosure. Antisymmetry yields equality with top.
